![Sunset by the sea — Photo by G.A. Botero](image-1.jpg){fig-alt="Sunset by the sea — Photo by G.A. Botero"}

I long to be one of them \
I bought the leather journal, the special pen \
I am bohemian, I dress the part \
I sit here hoping for a sunset spark \
but my page is light \
as the day gets dark
